screens.name: Home
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows a dominant orb, separate question whisper and unavailable omen; supplied browser evidence supports proportional layout checks; A 8.0, F 7.3, overall 7.6 provisional.
findings: Give the unavailable omen a clearer recovery path while retaining the orb as the primary action.

screens.name: Approach
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 pairs visually consistent entry and settled frames with “Opening your question,” while the supplied evidence describes automatic advancement after 650ms; A 8.0, F 7.0, overall 7.4 provisional.
findings: Verify that automatic advancement communicates progress without requiring users to read the brief intermediate message.

screens.name: Ask
screens.evidence: Sheets 01–02 show a labeled question field, voice alternative and distinct submit button, with a supplied passing real typing flow; A 8.0, F 7.7, overall 7.8 provisional.
findings: Verify keyboard appearance preserves access to the question and submit action on a physical phone.

screens.name: Ask — 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows readable enlarged input and disclosure but no submit action within the captured viewport, despite supplied no-overflow measurements; A 7.3, F 6.7, overall 6.9 provisional.
findings: Reduce decorative space at enlarged text and verify that scrolling with the keyboard open reaches submission.

screens.name: Listening — microphone unavailable
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows a microphone failure notice, retry entry and typing fallback in both frames, while hardware voice operation remains unverified; A 7.7, F 7.7, overall 7.7 provisional.
findings: Integrate the failure notice more closely with the listening controls so the recovery path reads as one group.

screens.name: Planning — loading
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows consistent loading frames with stage description, expected wait, credit reassurance and Cancel; A 8.0, F 7.7, overall 7.8 provisional.
findings: Verify that stage changes and cancellation results are announced by assistive technology.

screens.name: Question card 1
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows consistent entry and settled layouts with numbered progress and four underlined options; A 8.0, F 7.0, overall 7.4 provisional.
findings: Make it clearer whether choosing an answer immediately advances the flow.

screens.name: Question card 2
screens.evidence: Sheets 02–03 preserve question placement and option rhythm while progress changes to 2 of 3; A 8.0, F 7.3, overall 7.6 provisional.
findings: Show a perceptible selected confirmation before advancing to the next question.

screens.name: Question card 3
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows the final question with consistent answer rows and 3 of 3 progress; A 8.0, F 7.3, overall 7.6 provisional.
findings: Clarify that the final answer begins prediction generation.

screens.name: Question card — custom answer
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows a checked custom option, labeled empty input and disabled Continue, but the orb is visibly cut across its upper portion in both frames; A 7.0, F 7.7, overall 7.4 provisional.
findings: Remove the hard orb crop when the custom-answer form expands or scrolls.

screens.name: Question card — custom answer at 200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows enlarged options, selected custom entry and disabled Continue, while the question is outside the captured view with a clipped text remnant near the header; A 6.7, F 6.7, overall 6.7 provisional.
findings: Keep the question context available and prevent partial text from appearing beneath the fixed header.

screens.name: Research — loading
screens.evidence: Sheets 09–10 retain loading structure and recovery copy, with a stronger smoke plume behind the upper controls; A 7.7, F 7.7, overall 7.7 provisional.
findings: Constrain smoke brightness near controls throughout the loading animation.

screens.name: Reveal
screens.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show a readable settled forecast and multiple follow-up actions, but the mid-entry forecast is substantially dimmer; A 7.7, F 7.3, overall 7.5 provisional.
findings: Keep the forecast legible during entry and distinguish immediate actions from later follow-up actions.

screens.name: Reveal — expanded explanation
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows the expanded explanation beginning below a large retained forecast block, with supplied evidence of successful Why interaction; A 7.0, F 7.7, overall 7.4 provisional.
findings: Compact the retained hero area when expanded so more explanation is visible immediately.

screens.name: Check-in
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 places outcome choices beside the forecast and supplied replay evidence reports outcome persistence, while Share remains the strongest button; A 7.3, F 7.3, overall 7.3 provisional.
findings: Make recording an outcome the primary visual task when entering check-in.

screens.name: Share
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows a stable preview and three export destinations, while supplied proof covers PNG export rather than every listed destination; A 7.7, F 7.0, overall 7.3 provisional.
findings: Explain the private-link audience and show availability for destinations that depend on unavailable services.

screens.name: Story export
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows a coherent story card and clear export button, supported by supplied actual PNG export and synthetic export-failure recovery evidence; A 8.0, F 7.7, overall 7.8 provisional.
findings: Verify export completion and return navigation through the physical device share flow.

screens.name: History — empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows a clear empty-state explanation, local-storage disclosure and Ask action with consistent transition placement; A 8.0, F 7.7, overall 7.8 provisional.
findings: Give the empty-state Ask action a more explicit button affordance.

screens.name: History — populated
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 differentiates date, original question, forecast and Waiting status, with supplied history-persistence proof; A 8.0, F 7.3, overall 7.6 provisional.
findings: Clarify that the history row opens the reading and what Waiting refers to.

screens.name: History — 20-item stress
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 shows repeated readable rows with the lowest visible forecast passing behind the fixed tab bar; A 7.3, F 7.0, overall 7.1 provisional.
findings: Verify the final row can scroll fully above the tab bar and raised Ask orb.

screens.name: Sky — offline sample stars
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 labels offline sample content, offers Retry and connects a selected category to a question and CTA; A 8.0, F 7.7, overall 7.8 provisional.
findings: Add a non-color selected marker to the active star category.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 states offline status before disabled creation and sharing controls, consistent with the supplied control evidence; A 8.0, F 7.7, overall 7.8 provisional.
findings: Keep the reason for unavailable controls programmatically associated with those controls.

screens.name: You — empty memory and settings
screens.evidence: Sheets 12 and 14 show plan, empty memory and preferences, with supplied edit/forget/Undo proof but the privacy row visually intersecting the raised tab orb; A 8.0, F 7.7, overall 7.8 provisional.
findings: Increase the final content inset so the privacy action clears the raised navigation orb.

screens.name: Settings — keyboard focus
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows a strong row focus outline, and supplied browser evidence reports 342×52px targets, keyboard activation, persistence and a passing axe scan; A 8.0, F 8.0, overall 8.0 provisional.
findings: Verify switch names, values and focus order with a physical-device screen reader.

screens.name: Settings — 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows enlarged settings with readable toggles but a clipped text fragment under the header and crowded privacy content above navigation; A 7.0, F 7.0, overall 7.0 provisional.
findings: Fix header and bottom-navigation insets for enlarged, scrolled settings.

screens.name: Plans
screens.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show explicit billing units, test-mode labeling and selected annual pricing, while the settled frame clips the orb under the header; A 7.3, F 7.7, overall 7.5 provisional.
findings: Remove the partial orb at the top of the scrolled plan view.

screens.name: Plans — 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 retains readable plan prices and the primary button at enlarged text, with awkward wrapping in price and billing columns; A 7.3, F 7.7, overall 7.5 provisional.
findings: Stack price and billing details at large text instead of retaining two narrow columns.

screens.name: Planning error
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 clearly presents failure, no-charge reassurance, Try again and Edit question across both frames; A 8.0, F 7.7, overall 7.8 provisional.
findings: Verify that retry preserves the question and announces the new loading state.

screens.name: Prediction error
screens.evidence: Sheets 05–06 add Review answers to clear retry and edit recovery, while smoke brightens the close-control region; A 7.7, F 7.7, overall 7.7 provisional.
findings: Maintain stable control contrast against the moving error-screen atmosphere.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect — planning
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows a clear boundary, support route, alternative question and no-credit/no-memory reassurance, with supplied real redirect evidence; A 7.7, F 7.7, overall 7.7 provisional.
findings: Give the support route greater visual priority relative to asking another entertainment question.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect — prediction
screens.evidence: Sheets 11–12 preserve the support and recovery structure through entry, with brighter smoke behind the upper controls; A 7.3, F 7.7, overall 7.5 provisional.
findings: Prioritize support and preserve consistent contrast during the redirect transition.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: The orb consistently anchors the sheets but is hard-clipped in custom-answer and settled Plans views; A 7.5, F 7.0, overall 7.2 provisional.
findings: Scale or move the whole orb out of view instead of exposing hard rectangular clipping.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Persistent labeled tabs show an underlined active destination, while the raised Ask orb overlaps nearby content in several captures; A 7.7, F 7.7, overall 7.7 provisional.
findings: Reserve content clearance for the full raised orb and verify enlarged navigation labels.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Headers consistently separate identity from remaining readings, and supplied replay evidence verifies balance changes after simulated purchase; A 8.0, F 7.7, overall 7.8 provisional.
findings: Ensure the fixed header fully masks scrolled text without cutting through visible artwork.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream rounded buttons provide strong emphasis and visible disabled variants, with supplied successful action flows but no physical interaction checks; A 8.0, F 7.7, overall 7.8 provisional.
findings: Verify pressed, pending and disabled announcements consistently across all primary actions.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold text and underlined rows represent several different action types, with the reveal collecting many similarly weighted links; A 7.7, F 7.0, overall 7.3 provisional.
findings: Group secondary actions by purpose and make standalone text actions visibly tappable.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Underlined rows maintain a consistent rhythm and custom selection uses both a checkmark and gold, but standard selected states are not shown; A 8.0, F 7.0, overall 7.4 provisional.
findings: Apply the explicit selected treatment to ordinary answers before automatic advancement.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: The normal input has a visible label, readable entered text and strong rectangular outline, supported by supplied real input completion; A 7.7, F 7.7, overall 7.7 provisional.
findings: Use one clear field boundary rather than the closely stacked outer outline and bottom rule.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: The enlarged question occupies most of its viewport and the enlarged custom form loses visible question context despite reported zero horizontal overflow; A 7.0, F 6.7, overall 6.8 provisional.
findings: Adapt surrounding layout at 200% so the field, question context and completion path remain easy to reach.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheet 12 shows distinct switch positions and row focus, supported by measured targets and successful label, keyboard and persistence checks; A 8.0, F 8.0, overall 8.0 provisional.
findings: Confirm accessible switch state and activation using VoiceOver and TalkBack.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheet 07 shows only the unavailable omen with a next-day instruction and no visible immediate retry; A 7.7, F 6.7, overall 7.1 provisional.
findings: Explain whether waiting is required or provide Retry when the failure is recoverable.

components.name: Sky star and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 13 links labeled sample stars to a selected question, with selection distinguished primarily by gold coloring; A 8.0, F 7.3, overall 7.6 provisional.
findings: Add a shape or text selection cue and verify the full category target bounds.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 05 presents a borderless offline group with privacy explanation, Retry and disabled creation, while connected behavior is unverified; A 8.0, F 7.7, overall 7.8 provisional.
findings: Retain this explicit availability explanation when adding connected and invitation states.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheet 06 separates date, question, forecast and status clearly but does not visibly identify the row as an action; A 8.0, F 7.0, overall 7.4 provisional.
findings: Add a restrained opening affordance and describe the Waiting status more specifically.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show explicit billing periods and checked annual selection, with less comfortable column wrapping at 200%; A 7.7, F 7.7, overall 7.7 provisional.
findings: Switch to a single-column pricing arrangement when text is enlarged.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show a consistent export composition, though disclaimer and brand text are tiny in the smaller preview; A 7.7, F 7.7, overall 7.7 provisional.
findings: Keep key qualification text readable at the size recipients typically view the exported story.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Error, offline and microphone states explicitly disclose failure and offer relevant alternatives, with supplied recovery evidence but no screen-reader announcement proof; A 7.7, F 7.7, overall 7.7 provisional.
findings: Standardize notice placement and verify that status changes are announced without moving focus unexpectedly.

components.name: Typography
components.evidence: Serif headings, script ritual phrases and sans-serif controls establish consistent roles, while small supporting text and enlarged layouts remain uneven; A 7.7, F 7.5, overall 7.6 provisional.
findings: Improve supporting-text legibility and reflow layouts around enlarged type instead of only increasing font size.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: Dark gold mist supports the material direction, but bright smoke competes with content in reveal and error frames and the current performance trace is unfinished; A 7.0, F 7.0, overall 7.0 provisional.
findings: Limit atmospheric contrast beneath text and controls, then verify reduced-motion and current transition performance.

limitations: Scores are provisional: screenshots were evaluated directly, while runtime results are supplied evidence rather than independently reproduced checks.
A is the mean of applicable aesthetic dimensions, F the mean of applicable functional dimensions, and overall is 0.4A + 0.6F calculated before rounding.
All settled screens and represented variants are covered; corresponding transition frames inform their screen scores rather than receiving duplicate grades.
Static transition samples show composition and intermediate visibility, but cannot establish smoothness, timing, focus continuity or motion-preference compliance.
The current motion trace is unfinished; the supplied preceding trace does not independently establish this candidate's performance.
No physical iPhone, native Dynamic Type, keyboard-safe-area, VoiceOver, TalkBack, microphone, haptic, real-payment, connected-social or OS-share-sheet certification is available.
Reported overflow and axe passes do not establish complete reading order, touch usability, contrast throughout animation or primary-action access with a native keyboard.
Offscreen controls and partial scrolled content are not proven unreachable; no hard-gate failure is conclusively established by these sheets.
Synthetic reading and explanation wording is fixture evidence, not a production-copy defect or proof of model quality.
The authorized A >=9 and F >=9 threshold is not met by any evaluated screen or component; no 9/10 certification is supported.
topFixes: Fix header and navigation overlap in custom-answer, Plans and settings views, including scrolled 200% layouts.
Reflow enlarged inputs and pricing so context and completion actions remain easy to reach with the keyboard open.
Keep text and controls consistently legible throughout mist and entry transitions.
Make answer advancement, history-row activation and Sky selection more explicit.
Prioritize outcome recording on check-in and support access on sensitive redirects.
Complete current transition verification and physical-device assistive, keyboard and native-flow checks before seeking premium certification.
